Difficulty Class determines success or failure with a single roll.

GMs: Establish intent, trigger, and outcome before rolling against DC 12 to avoid pointless arguments.

Weapon of Warning (Rapier): humble gear with main-character energy when the table gets creative.

DMs: Position the party within 30 feet of the Weapon of Warning (Rapier) to ensure Advantage on Initiative rolls.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Healing restores 1 HP per night while adventuring, 2 HP with full bed rest.

Judges: Remind them that ignoring bed rest means dragging that bum knee through every encounter until it's fully healed.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Playing on a Grid means each square represents 5 feet.

DMs: Enforce 5-foot square movement to avoid disputes and keep your game from devolving into a geometry lesson.

The Witch's Familiar allows spells to originate from its location, not yours.

GMs: Remind players the Familiar's range is their spell range; keep it out of harm's way for maximum utility.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Heal restores 70 Hit Points and ends Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions instantly.

DMs: Use Heal when 70 hit points and condition removal can prevent your party from wasting multiple actions on recovery.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Laulich is perfect for a playful encounter that can still punish bad habits.

Judges: Force the players to exploit the terrain to stay beyond Laulich's 60-foot magic suppression field or waste their spells.

Magic Circle requires Focus to maintain.

GMs: Keep the caster's Focus uninterrupted; one slip and that Magic Circle's gone, leaving them wide open.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Gold Dragon Wyrmling is the classic 'easy fight' that gets weird fast if players autopilot.

Players: laugh first, then respect turn economy before this joke encounter snowballs.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

The Sword of Air and Darkness transports targets to the ethereal plane on a natural 19-20.

Judges: When they roll a natural 19-20, remind them to exploit the 1d6 rounds of ethereal isolation.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Hard lesson: Torch and Light.

GMs: Set a timer for each torch; when it hits 60 minutes, remind them they're in the dark.

DMs: Remind your Fey Wanderer to choose subclass features that prioritize consistent 1d4 psychic damage over redundant effects like Hunter's Mark.
